ssh.detail: Prepare leaves current pointer and gateway untouched; activation switches and restarts.

ssh.detail: Activation restarts existing systemd unit, interrupting service.

ssh.detail: Dedicated Codex unsupported.

rows.name: Persist dedicated transport authentication across retries

docker.detail: Source-inferred retry gap, unreproduced: a fresh token is generated each prepare, while a healthy existing Agent is reused; rebuilding only gateway can supply a different token.

kubernetes.detail: Both roles reference the same persisted Agent-owned transport Secret; initial provisioning generates transport bytes only if that group is absent. This source evidence does not prove every runtime retry or external rotation scenario.

ssh.detail: Dedicated transport unsupported.

ssh.detail: At the reviewed baseline, the trusted-proxy unit omitted its generated gateway credential file. The current Driver supports password or trusted-proxy authentication only; see the current Driver reference.
